senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. שָׁלַק Pi.) trimmings, coiled and hairy substances covering gourds &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:2">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>משישלק</he>, ib. I, 5) <he>מאן דו ירים ש׳</he> when he removes the trimmings; cmp. <cite ref="Q01500"><he>פַּקְסוּסַיָּה</he></cite>.
